answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the violet of a task receipt, and the dune is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on receipt hashes checked against public logs before trust. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the tide of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
